messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: private-controlplane-heartbeat (severity: P1) for customer AcmeOps. routed to oncall: @Sasha K. link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345
Sasha K: acked. I'm on it. pulling recent heartbeats now.
Sasha K: quick status: control-plane agents for customer show intermittent websocket disconnects from our control plane starting ~08:11 UTC. customer-reported symptoms: API timeouts and failed config pushes.
pagerduty: Alert escalated to Level 2 after 5m (no resolution). calling: @Raj P.
Raj P: joining. tagging networking folks. @Maya C can you watch for packet drops on the peering?
Maya C: looking. I see increased RST/ICMP unreachable from 10.2.0.0/16 -> our control-plane IPs around 08:10-08:13 UTC. No obvious route changes in our cloud route table.
Jordan L: pulled onprem-agent logs from AcmeOps (last 30m) via s3://redwood-collector/acmeops/agents/2024-06-29.log. snippet:
```
[2024-06-29T08:09:58Z] agent: heartbeat: sending
[2024-06-29T08:10:12Z] agent: tcp_connect: dial tcp 52.10.11.23:443: i/o timeout
[2024-06-29T08:10:12Z] agent: reconnecting in 3s
[2024-06-29T08:10:15Z] agent: heartbeat: failed (tls handshake)
[2024-06-29T08:12:58Z] agent: heartbeat: sending
```
Sasha K: looks like brief connectivity blackholes every ~2min. Is this single region for AcmeOps?
Maya C: yes, all agent traffic originates from their colo ASN 64512 via transit peer, appears to egress through a single carrier. I can see BGP flap entries at their edge around 08:09-08:13.
AcmeOps Support: confirming they saw a brief maintenance window on their router at 08:10 for a firmware push. They thought it was non-disruptive but their monitoring showed TCP resets.
Sasha K: customer impact: control plane heartbeats failing intermittently -> their agents fail to receive config updates and some short-running deployments returned 502s. Not a global outage but impacts a single customer. Marking impacted_customers: [AcmeOps].
ops-bot: Created incident record INC-20240629-1719723456, severity=P1, assignees=[Sasha K,Raj P], runbook=/runbooks/private-controlplane-heartbeat.md
Raj P: mitigation plan: 1) ask customer to pause router/fw push (if in progress) 2) temporarily accept fallback path via our secondary ingress (we can add an ACL allowing source ASN until their change completes) 3) increase agent reconnect backoff to avoid thundering herd while we stabilize
Sasha K: messaging to customer drafted: "We see control-plane connectivity interruptions correlated with a router firmware push at your edge. Our engineers can accept a temporary secondary path or wait for the push to finish. Which do you prefer?"
AcmeOps Support: prefer we accept secondary path while they finish validation (~20min). Go ahead.
Maya C: applying temporary BGP import/ACL to accept traffic via secondary transit. Will push in 30s.
Maya C: pushed config: bgp import policy updated to prefer peer B, temporary acl allow ASN 64512 -> controlplane; propagation in progress.
Jordan L: onprem agents before/after:
```
# before: tcpdump shows SYN then RST
08:10:11.234234 IP 10.2.1.12.54321 > 52.10.11.23.443: Flags [S], seq 12345
08:10:11.334567 IP 52.10.11.23.443 > 10.2.1.12.54321: Flags [R]
# after: established handshake, heartbeat flows
08:13:00.123456 IP 10.2.1.12.54321 > 52.10.11.23.443: Flags [S]
08:13:00.223789 IP 52.10.11.23.443 > 10.2.1.12.54321: Flags [S.]
```
Sasha K: seeing heartbeats recover at 08:13 UTC. agent reconnect spikes reduced.
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert PD12345 auto-acknowledged at 08:14 UTC (incident resolved).
pagerduty: Escalation cleared.
AcmeOps Support: confirming metrics look good now, rolling back internal change on their validation path in 10m.
Sasha K: next steps documented: - keep temporary ACL for 30m after stability - we will schedule a post-mortem call with AcmeOps to coordinate maintenance windows - add an evaluation of agent backoff parameters for noisy edge scenarios
Raj P: handoff to night oncall @Jordan L in 2h. Jordan, please monitor the BGP session and agent heartbeat rate for the next 3 hours.
Jordan L: ack, will watch. set a short alert to trigger if heartbeat loss > 5% for more than 2 consecutive 5m windows.
Sasha K: brief incident summary for ticketing:
- Incident ID: INC-20240629-1719723456
- Impact: Intermittent control-plane connectivity and API timeouts for a single private/VPC customer (AcmeOps) during a router firmware push at their edge, 08:09-08:13 UTC.
- Root cause (prelim): transient BGP/edge router maintenance causing TCP resets to our control plane endpoints.
- Mitigation: accepted secondary transit path and applied temporary ACL; agent heartbeats recovered by ~08:13 UTC.
- Action items: post-mortem with customer, review agent reconnect/backoff, consider runbook update to include secondary-path acceptance steps.
AcmeOps Support: thanks for the quick turnaround. thumbs up :thumbsup:
Sasha K: closing thread, saving logs and notes to INC-20240629 in the incident tracker.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20240629-1719723456 transitioned to status: RESOLVED.
